row.title: Bot PRs blocked because their pull_request run waited in action_required
row.body: A PR opened with the workflow token raises a pull_request run that sits in action_required; that pending run is the required checks status, so the merge API said checks is expected although the dispatched run passed. The lane now approves such runs on every pass (LANE-APPROVE-1).
